purpose: Practical teaching breakdown: subtopics, question families and skill groupings that help a candidate prepare but that the official syllabus does not name. Deliberately separate from knowledge/official/ so it can never be read as official.
blocked_reason: The official syllabus these nodes anchor to does not exist yet (B-09), and no expert source or past paper has been ingested (B-08, B-02). A breakdown of an unread syllabus would be invention.

node_shape.title: the practical topic name as taught
node_shape.official_anchor: node_id in knowledge/official/syllabus.json, or the literal string NO_OFFICIAL_ANCHOR
node_shape.anchor_justification: why this node belongs under that official node, or why nothing official covers it
derived_from: source ids, paper ids, question ids, or a recorded reasoning note
node_shape.teaching_note: what a candidate is expected to be able to do

rules: official_anchor is either a resolvable official node id or the literal NO_OFFICIAL_ANCHOR. Silence is not allowed.
Never write T1_OFFICIAL as a tier in this file.
derived_from must be non-empty. A node no one can trace is a rumour.
Adding a node here never edits knowledge/official/syllabus.json. The official syllabus changes only when an official document does.
